principle: Evidence-based, multi-dimensional, conservative mastery. The LLM never decides mastery alone.

per_item_fields.item_id: stable HSK official key or internal expression id
per_item_fields.error_signatures: bounded array; aggregate patterns, not endless reminders

status_rules.red: new, failed, answer supplied, or pronunciation/tone clearly below threshold
status_rules.orange: understood/usable but fragile, guided, hesitant, or pronunciation not yet strong
status_rules.green: very good pronunciation/tone + spontaneous use + durable delayed recall evidence
status_rules.durable_green: 5 correct productions total and >=3 delayed recalls on different sessions; 4 delayed recalls preferred when fragile
status_rules.downgrade: never from one isolated miss; repeated failures on separated review opportunities can lower memory strength/status
